notes.title: Patch Notes - v2024.09.09
notes.content:
NEWS
- XP bonus for the initial 20 levels

CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS
- Reduced skill cooldowns by at least 50%
- Balanced strength of initial wild daemons
- Reduced essence consumption to upgrade daemons

FIXES
- Fast-transform button is getting stuck on a single daemon

notes.title: Patch Notes - v2024.08.09
notes.content:
**NEW FEATURES**  
- A quick transformation button in human mode has been added  
- Item for returning/teleporting to the registered respawn point  
- All players will receive 5 days of free Golden Pass when they reach level 2 *(older players will also receive it, and those who already have a Golden Pass will get an extra 5 days added to their time)*  
- Camera distance settings  
- HUD size settings  
- FPS limit settings  

**CHANGES AND IMPROVEMENTS**  
- Improvements to the tutorial/first minutes of gameplay, reducing the length of the tutorial and making the game more intuitive for new players.  
- Prioritize Revive button over Upgrade in the daemon bar when the daemon dies  
- Option to show/hide the top menu  

**FIXES**  
- Fixed several visual camera bugs on various maps, especially the ones that caused lines to appear on the map *(a few may still exist depending on the device's resolution)*  
- Vibration settings not working/saving

notes.title: NEW UPDATE IS COMING
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904758/5a352523f4593b453e50f8a75f333539093183ad.jpg

ey guys, how's it going?
We'll soon have an update aimed at assisting beginner players. One of the biggest demands and criticisms regarding the game is that players don't know what to do or where to go. So, with that in mind, we're working on ways to better guide everyone. In the image, we have the new 'Map Mode', which will indicate important NPCs, chests, and the recommended level for the region where the player is located. With this, they'll know if there's something interesting there and can then explore accordingly.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE - v2024.4.1
notes.content:
NEWS
- A group/party system with EXP, syEXP, and loot sharing has been implemented.
- A new screen has been created to display player information; simply click/tap on a character. This screen also includes options to invite, kick, or leave a party.
- A protection system for absorption and loot has been developed for the player who lands the final blow on Daemons (this protection does not apply to party members).
- The Tasks system has been enhanced; now players can redo tasks 6 hours after they were 'collected', however, this will be 6 hours of online time, meaning time will pause while offline.
- A points distribution system for attributes has been introduced, where each level generates 1 point to distribute among Power, Resilience, Health Points, and Speed. Each point will result in a 1% increase in the attribute. (It will be possible to reset point allocation for 10 gems).
- A notification system has been implemented to prompt players to update the game version when it becomes outdated; however, this will only be effective for versions higher than v2024.4.1.
- Regions on the map now have names and will appear on the screen as players enter them.
- A prompt asking players to rate the game in stores will now appear when reaching level 10.
- The game now features a support guidance and direction button to assist players.

CHANGES, IMPROVEMENTS, and FIXES
- The Power-UP Medical Kit has been adjusted to reduce its active potion usage, thereby avoiding potion waste.
- The Golden Pass will no longer reset its time when the player disconnects; it will continue the timer from where it stopped.
- It is now possible to use D-Trap and absorb Daemons of a higher level than the human character.
- Various sound effects have had their volume reduced as they were found to be irritating, such as: Happy, Darkky, Venny, Dynomander, etc.
- A button has been added to close notifications that appear at the top of the screen.
- When a daemon leaves its respawn area, it will not disappear as long as a player is battling with it.
- The stun duration has been reduced from 6s to 3s.
- Leafrend's poison attack has been replaced by a plant-type attack.
- The mission description to find the 'Druid' has been improved, now mentioning the NPC's name and location in the mission text.
- The duration of the Golden Pass has been added to the description on the purchase screen.
- It is no longer possible to transform into a Daemon that has a level higher than the human form.
- A timer has been added to correctly display the cooldown of daemon transformations.
- The Wild Synergy system has been balanced so that daemons with a synergy higher than the strongest player nearby will not respawn.
- A bug that sometimes kept the character connected to the server, preventing the player from reconnecting to the game, has been fixed.
- Upon leveling up, a notification will now appear at the top of the screen.
- Characters will now lose 25% of EXP upon death and clicking 'Respawn,' but choosing 'Revive' will not result in EXP loss (the player will never de-level).
- Clicking outside the chat window will close it, particularly helpful for mobile players.
- When a daemon has enough syEXP to be upgraded, its synergy bar will turn gold in the shortcuts so that the player can better perceive that it already has enough syEXP.
- Improvement in the character movement system, you will notice a significant improvement in response time while walking.
- Game optimization for mobile, which means the game will not overheat the phone and will consume much less battery.
- Balancing the synergy evolution percentage according to the ranking (previously 1 and 2 stars had a 1% gain for each synergy, now 2 stars will have 1.5%).
- Happy has received a nerf, he has returned to being a two-star, as the intention is for only his EVO version to be three stars (to have a greater reason to conquer the EVO version).

notes.title: A new UPDATE is coming this week
notes.content:
🎯 Attribute point distribution system in human form to improve Power, Toughness, Max HP and Speed (for human and Dameon)
🎯 Prevent daemons from disappearing if there is an active and nearby target/player.
🎯 Reduce the volume of the happy, darkky, and venny daemon skins, as they were irritatingly loud.
🎯 Party/group system to play and share EXP with your friends
🎯 Replace the poison attack with a plant-based one on leafrend, as it makes more sense for it to have 2 Grass-type attacks.
🎯 Implement capture and loot protection system for the player who dealt the final blow (prioritize for a few seconds).
🎯 Slightly decrease EXP upon death, as currently there is no punishment, and death can be used as a teleport.
🎯 Close the chat window when clicking outside of it (will greatly assist mobile users, as the close button is small).
🎯 Allow absorption of daemons of a higher level than the human, but don't allow transformation until the human reaches the required level.
🎯 Reduce stun duration, as it's currently too long.
🎯 Allow task redoing after 6 hours online.
🎯 Bug fix preventing connection by displaying a message stating the player is already online.
🎯 Balance the Wild Synergy, where daemons won't respawn beyond the player's maximum synergy level (considering all daemons' synergy, and the one with the highest synergy will be used as the 'maximum' for respawn wild synergy).
🎯 Don't allow transformation into a daemon of a higher level than the human.
🎯 Allow closing of messages/notifications, as sometimes they overlap with the UI (added a close button on the right).
🎯 Don't reset the Golden Ticket timer upon disconnection (i.e., the timer continues from where it left off upon reconnection).
🎯 Add an in-game support button to guide players needing assistance to Discord.
🎯 Implement a version update warning system to prevent login, as outdated versions may cause bugs.
🎯 Change the color of wild daemon level plates according to their ranking/stars.
🎯 Highlight when a daemon can be upgraded better on the shortcut bar, without needing to open the daemon panel.
🎯 Name map regions and display them on the screen upon entry, so players can locate themselves by the map name.
🎯 Several other improvements and fixes
